description: Reviewed polity-capital history used only to place Person Activities on the spacetime view. Empty by design until capital periods are source-reviewed; the UI must leave unresolved placements unresolved rather than infer from names, modern countries, birthplace or travel.
placement_rule: Use the capital of the Activity's linked Polity for the overlapping historical period. A capital change may split only the visual placement, never the authoritative Activity.

capital_periods.start_year: historical integer year or null; year 0 forbidden
capital_periods.end_year: historical integer year or null; year 0 forbidden
capital_periods.capital_place_id: future first-class Place UUID or null
source_refs: one or more reviewed source identifiers
